steps.npc: This fairy ring will take you out of Zanaris. It leads to the place known as Al-Kharid in your realm. Once passed you can not return this way.
Before leaving make sure that you have fully sampled the delights of our marketplace.

options.text: I think I'll stay down here a bit longer.

steps.player: I think I'll stay down here a bit longer.

steps.text: (The player walks into the centre of the fairy ring and gets teleported to slightly west of Al Kharid bank.)
